name: iQ Great Newton House
description: Next to the Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine and close to the Royal Liverpool Hospital, so ideal for medicine and health students. Breakfast bar, terrace and 24/7 staff.

name: Capital Gate
description: Practically on the University of Liverpool’s doorstep and two minutes from the hospital, with a 24/7 on-site team. Listed as alcohol-free.

name: Pembroke Studios
description: A smaller, quieter studio building beside the Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine. A good pick if you want your own space close to campus and the hospital.

name: Albert Court
description: On busy London Road, with supermarkets and takeaways outside the door. Free 24/7 gym, study spaces and a shop on site.

name: St Andrew’s Gardens
description: Known locally as “the Bullring”: a curved 1930s building turned into flats around a courtyard garden. Seven minutes from campus and often good value.

name: Windsor Court
description: Good value on London Road, seven minutes from campus, with bus stops and shops right outside. Games area, study area and an outdoor courtyard.

name: Plato House
description: A smaller, homely building just off London Road, with a cinema room, games room and a cleaner for the shared areas. Eight minutes from campus.

name: One Islington Plaza
description: A large modern tower north of London Road with a gym, cinema room and games room. Around ten minutes’ walk to the University of Liverpool.

name: Shamrock House
description: Shared apartments on a side street off London Road, good for living with a small group of friends. Eight minutes from campus.

name: Innovo House
description: A relaxed, mid-sized building on a quiet road off London Road. A TV in every kitchen, a lounge and a pool table, ten minutes from campus.

name: Calico
description: A modern building with a sky lounge, games pods, cinema room and gym. About ten minutes from both universities and Lime Street.

name: Lennon Studios
description: Studios just south of the University of Liverpool, about five minutes from lectures. Pool and foosball tables, outdoor space and a 24/7 team.

name: Hope Street
description: On one of Liverpool’s prettiest streets, between the two cathedrals and surrounded by restaurants. Gym, cinema room and a sun terrace.

name: Haigh Court
description: In the Georgian Quarter near Hope Street and LIPA, with lounges, green outdoor areas and lifts to every floor.

name: Maple House
description: A small, calm building in the quiet streets between Hope Street and Myrtle Street. Eight minutes from campus, with a lift and outdoor space.

name: The Electra
description: Near Hope Street and handy for both the University of Liverpool and LJMU. Lounge, games area and a study zone, with 24/7 support.

name: Chatham Lodge
description: Studios and shared flats in the leafy streets just south of campus, near Abercromby Square. Gym, lift and laundry on site.

name: Hayward House
description: Studios and three-bedroom flats ten minutes from campus. Good bus links into town and out to south Liverpool.

name: The Hahnemann Building
description: A converted Victorian hospital on Hope Street, full of period character. Cinema, games room and study room, close to LIPA and LJMU.

name: Fusion Liverpool
description: Self-contained apartments with a basketball court, karaoke room and free laundry. Between Chinatown, the Georgian Quarter and the cathedral.

name: The Arch
description: Named after the Chinatown Arch just outside, with Chinese restaurants and supermarkets on the doorstep. Cinema area, study zones and a courtyard.

name: Benson Yard
description: On a quiet Ropewalks side street near Bold Street’s cafés, with a cinema room, sky lounge, music room and gym. Five minutes from LJMU’s Mount Pleasant buildings.

name: Grand Central
description: A big, lively hall next to Lime Street Station, ideal if you’ll travel by train. Games tables, an outdoor social space and a 24/7 team.

name: Horizon Heights
description: A newer tower right behind Lime Street Station, with a sky lounge, cinema room and private dining room. About ten minutes’ walk up to the University of Liverpool.

name: The Lantern
description: Between Lime Street and Central stations, close to Bold Street and Chinatown. Gym, games room and a regular residents’ events programme.

name: Iconinc The Ascent
description: A premium building with a large gym, sauna, steam room and private cinema. A minute from Bold Street and Central station.

name: Byrom Point
description: One of the closest homes to LJMU’s City Campus, with a gym, a library-style study area and strong security, including a night patrol. Listed as alcohol-free.

name: Vita Student Crosshall Street
description: A premium, hotel-style option near Liverpool ONE, with breakfast, housekeeping, gym classes and free bikes included. Priced at the higher end.

name: The Bridewell
description: In the heart of the business district, close to the Cavern Quarter and Liverpool ONE. On-site gym, a comfy lounge and a desk workstation in every room.

name: Marybone Student Village
description: A large, sociable hall on the edge of the business district, a couple of minutes from LJMU’s City Campus and Moorfields station. Gym, cinema room and a staffed reception.

name: Moorfield
description: Right beside LJMU’s City Campus, with a cinema room, study area and outdoor social space. The waterfront and Liverpool ONE are about ten minutes’ walk.

name: Yugo Ablett House
description: Next to LJMU’s City Campus, with skyline views from the upper floors, study rooms and a 24-hour reception. Well set up for accessibility.

name: Atlantic Point
description: On a quieter street just north of the centre, five minutes from LJMU’s City Campus. Common room with a pool table, outdoor space and an on-site team.

name: Glassworks
description: A smaller, no-fuss hall on Vauxhall Road with a gym, lounge and study space. A few minutes from LJMU’s City Campus and Moorfields station.

name: Europa
description: One of the more affordable purpose-built options near the centre. Lounge, games area and residents’ events, about twelve minutes from campus.

name: Prospect Point
description: A friendly building with communal kitchens, a dining area and regular social events. Strong security with a 24-hour team.

name: true Liverpool
description: A big, sociable building with a rooftop terrace and outdoor cinema, a 24/7 gym and free printing. About twelve minutes’ walk from campus.

name: Unity Square
description: On Shaw Street in Everton, close to Liverpool Hope’s Creative Campus. Courtyards, social spaces with big smart TVs and a 24/7 on-site team.

name: City Point
description: North of the centre, with lower rents and free car parking. Gym, concierge and a TV in every room, with buses into town.

name: Phoenix Place
description: A calmer spot north of the city centre, with a games room, picnic area and dishwashers in the flats. A short bus ride into town.

name: Poets Place
description: Bright, self-contained studios with full-length windows and brand-new appliances. A 24-hour concierge and secure parking; good for postgraduates.

name: Paddington Park House
description: Part of the new Paddington Village innovation district, eight minutes from campus. Very fast wired internet, a courtyard and 24-hour security.

name: Edge Hill 6-bed student houses
description: Six-bedroom houses for larger friendship groups, near Edge Hill station. Living room, rear yard and fast Wi-Fi.

name: The Railyard
description: Near the site of the historic Crown Street station, a few minutes from the University of Liverpool. BBQ area, outdoor space and social events.

name: Queensland Place
description: One of the more affordable options near campus, on the Edge Hill side. Gym, media room and games room, close to Edge Hill station.

name: Kensington 5-bed student houses
description: Five-bedroom houses with brand-new kitchens and shared bathrooms. Around fifteen minutes’ walk to campus, with buses on Edge Lane.

name: Kensington 4-bed student houses
description: Four-bedroom houses in Kensington, a popular student area east of the centre. Modern kitchens, a cosy living room and a rear yard.
